tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Light gets a 7% paper grain by default, dark never gets grain.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, nav, inputs. Sits on ground with a line border, never a shadow.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All body and heading text on ground and surface. 13.7:1 light, 14.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, captions on ground and surface. 5.2:1 light, 6.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and item dividers. Decorative only, never carries meaning.

tokens.name: cocoa
tokens.usage: Warm brown for quiet secondary text and the dark theme's base. On ground and surface.

tokens.name: pink-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, Know yourself cards and tags, hover fill behind pink items.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: The cursor block, moment dots, stickers. Dark: link color. Never body text in light.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Links in light, Know yourself eyebrow text, the wavy arrow. 5.0:1 on ground, 4.7:1 on pink-soft.

tokens.name: butter-soft
tokens.usage: Focus ring halo, highlighted lines in writing, warm empty states.

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: The prompt mark, the primary button fill, the dark focus ring, the star sticker. Text on it is ink in light and ground in dark.

tokens.name: honey
tokens.usage: Text version of butter on light grounds, for labels that must read, and the light focus ring. 5.1:1 on ground.

tokens.name: lilac-soft
tokens.usage: Think cards and tags, dotted dividers on writing pages, bubbles.

tokens.name: lilac
tokens.usage: Think moment dot, the keyboard sticker, the curved arrow in soft form.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Think eyebrow text and the curved arrow. 6.3:1 on ground.

tokens.name: mint-soft
tokens.usage: Check cards and tags, success pill fill.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Check moment dot, the wave section break, the wave sticker.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: Check eyebrow text and success pill text. 5.2:1 on ground and on mint-soft.

tokens.name: peach-soft
tokens.usage: Build cards and tags, the error state's soft background.

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Build moment dot, the ice cream and tea stickers.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Build eyebrow text and error text. 5.3:1 on ground, 5.2:1 on peach-soft. Errors always carry a prompt line, never color alone.

tokens.name: terminal
tokens.usage: The terminal body on any page. The front door of the site.

tokens.name: terminal-bar
tokens.usage: The terminal's title bar.

tokens.name: terminal-text
tokens.usage: Typed text inside the terminal. 15:1 on terminal.

tokens.name: terminal-muted
tokens.usage: Prompts, timestamps, help text inside the terminal. 7.4:1 on terminal.

tokens.name: on-butter
tokens.usage: Text on butter: the primary button label. 10:1 both themes.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links. Rose in light, pink in dark, underlined on hover only.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus ring on every focusable thing, 2px outside the edge, with a 4px butter-soft halo. Honey in light (5:1), butter in dark (11:1).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The name on the home top, page titles. One per page.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section titles, resource names on their own page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Almost all of it is free.
styles.usage: Paragraphs, card text, descriptions. Max 62ch wide.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions, dates, footnotes, the tagline under the name.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows on cards, section names after the prompt mark, the top-of-card label.

styles.name: terminal
styles.usage: Everything typed in the terminal, inline code, keywords in brackets.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks in writing and resource pages.

styles.name: sticker-word
styles.usage: Word stickers only (ship it, new, ok but why, it ran, built in a day). Never for UI text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its title, between tag and tag.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside small things: tag padding sides, list item padding, gap between card lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between cards, the page side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between sections. Airy on purpose, the page should breathe.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of any running text.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Max width of the page content.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, the Now card, resource tiles.

tokens.name: radius-terminal
tokens.usage: The terminal window and code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Tags, keyword chips, the moment label.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, word stickers, the success pill.

motion.note: Six moves and a never-moves list, in README. These are the durations and the one curve.

tokens.name: fast
tokens.usage: Hover lift, press, focus ring appearing.

tokens.name: base
tokens.usage: Cards entering, tags filtering, theme switch.

tokens.name: slow
tokens.usage: The terminal typing a line, a sticker settling.

tokens.name: ease
tokens.usage: The only curve. Quick out, soft landing.

tokens.name: blink
tokens.usage: The cursor block, infinite.

tokens.name: type
tokens.usage: A typed terminal line of about 26 characters.
